title: O Happy Day Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: With a name like "O Happy Day," you can expect to smile as soon as you spot this charming cottage located right next to the Gulf in Seaside, Florida. The character-rich cottage features whimsical decor and an open floor plan.
description_expanded: 61 SAVANNAH STREETO HAPPY DAY | SEASIDE, FLORIDA COTTAGE JUST 6 HOUSES FROM THE GULFO Happy Day is a bright and inviting Seaside, Florida vacation home located just six houses from the Gulf of Mexico. This charming coastal cottage features a distinctive orange exterior, private driveway parking, and a screened front porch with rocking chairs and a porch swing—ideal for morning coffee or relaxing evenings. Inside, the open living room offers soaring ceilings, designer furnishings, a large flat-screen TV, two club chairs, and a queen sleeper sofa.OPEN-CONCEPT LIVING & UPDATED KITCHENThe open-concept layout includes a dedicated dining room with a farmhouse table seating eight, perfect for family meals and gatherings. The adjacent kitchen is fully updated with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, bar seating for two, and generous cabinetry stocked with cookware. A side foyer provides access to the grill area, along with a rear laundry room for added convenience.FIRST-FLOOR BEDROOMS & UPDATED BATHSThe first floor includes two bedrooms. The front king bedroom offers front porch access, closets, and use of a shared nearby full bathroom with a tub/shower combination. The second bedroom at the rear is a serene queen bedroom with an ensuite bath with walk-in shower and French doors opening to the rear screened porch.SCREENED PORCH & PRIVATE FENCED YARDThe rear screened porch overlooks a fully fenced and gated private yard that extends from front to back. Outdoor amenities include comfortable seating, a picnic table for al fresco dining, and a lush lawn ideal for relaxing or yoga. An outdoor shower with separate access to the laundry and wet room provides a convenient rinse-off after beach days.PRIMARY SUITE & ICONIC SEASIDE TOWER ROOMUpstairs, the private primary suite features a king bed, large closet, and an ensuite bath with dual vanities and a tub/shower combination. A staircase leads to the enclosed Seaside tower room with a queen sleeper sofa, Juliet balcony, and elevated views across town—perfect for sunset watching.WALKABLE SEASIDE LOCATIONIdeally located within walking distance to the beach, Central Square, and more than 40 shops and restaurants, O Happy Day combines classic Seaside charm with modern comfort—making it an exceptional choice for your next coastal getaway.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registrationFEATURESApproximately 2,062 Square feet2-minute walk, 335 feet to beach access at Savannah Pavilion; largest residential beaches on 30A Outdoor shower on side of home with access to laundry homeOutdoor charcoal grillPrivate driveway with off street parking for onePeacock Alley Linens - Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay and starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No smoking allowed, of any kind inside or outside (including vaping and cigars). Additional cleaning fees will apply to repaint. No pets allowedSTR23-002143
